title: The introduced contact asks when to meet

objects.subject: Arjun <> Nikhil Bose (Quillstack)
objects.body:
Arjun, meet Nikhil Bose, the CTO of Quillstack. Nikhil, meet Arjun Rao, the founder of Nimbus Labs, who is building an AI chief of staff for founders. I'll let you two take it from here.

Introly

objects.subject: Re: Arjun <> Nikhil Bose (Quillstack)
objects.body:
Hi Arjun,

Thanks for the intro. Are you around on Thursday for a 30-minute call? If not, what times work for you next week?

Nikhil Bose
CTO, Quillstack
